name: Steam reformer (primary and secondary)
description: Fired tubular reactor in which natural gas or another light hydrocarbon reacts with steam over a nickel catalyst to make synthesis gas, followed in ammonia plants by a secondary reformer where air or oxygen is added and the remaining methane is converted. Reformers set the hydrogen-to-nitrogen ratio and the methane slip for the downstream shift and synthesis sections.
applications: hydrogen and ammonia synthesis gas production
